guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: acoustic fingerpicked guitar, dry intimate studio sound
tone.profile: acoustic fingerpicked guitar, dry intimate studio sound
tone.summary: A highly controlled, pristine signal chain using a clean preamp (US Deluxe) combined with minimal compression and subtle reverb to emulate the dry, fingerpicked intimacy of an acoustic recording.
corrections: Ollama draft targeted electric clean with modulation
drop all electric chorus tape delay plate reverb
prioritize acoustic guitar model over amp sim

rig.name: The Beatles - Strawberry Fields Forever (Acoustic) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Smooth out the dynamics of fingerpicked notes and add sustain.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 lacks a dedicated acoustic preamp, so compression is used to enhance clarity and consistency.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No gain or fuzz is desired.
Provide a clean, articulate tone suitable for acoustic emulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the cleanest option available to simulate an intimate studio sound without adding unwanted coloration.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a close-mic'd, dry studio sound.
blocks.gap: No dedicated acoustic IR is available; the US 2x12 provides the necessary clean, focused character.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the upper mids and highs to enhance fingerpicking clarity.
blocks.gap: Used for tonal shaping, compensating for the lack of a dedicated acoustic EQ curve.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No modulation or wah is desired.
Provide subtle space and depth without sounding like a rhythmic effect.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add dimension, avoiding the 'Tape' delay which might sound too vintage/lo-fi for this specific intimate setting.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle room ambience as requested, keeping the sound dry and intimate.
blocks.gap: The decay time must be kept short to avoid washing out the fingerpicking clarity.

improvements.summary: Replace generic IR with an acoustic-focused cabinet simulation.

proposals.recommendedAsset: acoustic guitar IR (e.g., small room mic'd)
proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too generic; a dedicated acoustic IR will improve clarity and intimacy.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased realism and focus on string attack.
